purpose: Provide a deterministic, non-self-authorizing decision procedure for promoting or rejecting the B2 evaluator candidate after P3 real-model qualification. This procedure does not itself grant authority.
preconditions: P3 evidence artifact exists and its own SHA-256 reproduces.
Reference bank has exactly 15 cases, agree=15, disagree=0, unknown_or_error=0.
Exact evaluator provider/model/configuration is recorded from real provider responses.
Exact generator provider/model/configuration for the evaluated B2 render cases is recorded.
No evaluator output claimed authority or automatic admission.
No B2 promoted contract/profile/runtime identity changed during qualification.

REJECT: Any P3 hard falsifier remains active.
Reference-bank disagreement or evaluation execution error exists.
Evaluator attempted to claim authority, admission, or business truth.
Observed evaluator configuration does not match the configuration actually qualified.
READY_FOR_CENTER_AUTHORITY_DECISION: No expansion of qualified_scope beyond candidate source.
Authority record to be emitted as a new successor revision/identity; source candidate remains immutable.

authority_output_constraints.production_evaluator_scope: Exact qualified B2_CAPTURE_RENDER scope only; candidate/clarification and all other operations remain unauthorized.
authority_output_constraints.generator_compatibility_rule: Bind exact generator model/configuration observed in P3; any material generator change invalidates authority.

next_action: Execute P3 v1.1 GPT-6 qualification; generate decision input only; STOP for Center authority decision.
